basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 28-year-old avid board game enthusiast based in Canmore, Alberta. I recently got into Reddit to connect with fellow board game lovers and to learn more about different gaming strategies. When I'm not playing Catan with friends or family, I'm either hiking in the beautiful Canadian Rockies or exploring new cafes in town. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to enjoy my hobbies. I usually log onto Reddit in the evenings after dinner, around 7 PM to 10 PM local time. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to dive deep into my interests, whether they're online or offline.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm relatively new to the world of Reddit and the specific rules of various subreddits. My primary source of knowledge comes from engaging in Catan discussions with friends and reading a few strategy guides online. I'm self-taught in most of my hobbies and enjoy learning through doing.
